# Car XQ — Langkawi Car Rental

> Family-owned car rental in Langkawi, Malaysia since 2015. Book online from RM 70/day with free delivery to Langkawi International Airport (LGK) Door 3, Kuah Ferry Jetty, or your hotel.

- [Home — car rental Langkawi](https://carxq.com/): Search dates, browse fleet, book in ~90 seconds
- [About Car XQ](https://carxq.com/about): Licensed operator since 2015, owned fleet, OKU-friendly vehicles, island-wide delivery
